name: goat-product-void
description: Product Void · Хоосон дэвсгэр: cuts the product out of the user's photo or clip and shows it alone in pure black or white space, Apple-style, with a slow push-in, one clean Mongolian headline and a price line in the product's own colour. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
